The bug was twofold: the credit-return/send paths were mutually exclusive (`if (credit_return) ... else if (send) ...`), so a decrement from `send` was dropped whenever a return happened in the same cycle, and the overflow sum was computed in the narrow `CW`-bit `credits` width, which could wrap instead of correctly detecting `S > N`. I rewrote the update to compute `S = credits - send + R` in a wider register (`CW+2` bits) per the spec's example 7, and saturate/raise `credit_err` only when `S > N`.

The design is now fixed — `TEST PASSED` with 0 errors on `tb/tb_visible.v`.
